title: Canonical strict quotient pullback tower isomorphism
statement: For a prime ell, finite E/Q_ell, any scheme map f:X -> Y and ordinary quotient model M on Y [def-trf-completion-unit-models], define the canonical natural isomorphism from M.quotient followed by degreewise sequence pullback and completed-coefficient restriction to the actual integral finite pullback tower [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower]. Take the mate of the direct-image evaluation comparison [lem-trf-ordinary-quotient-pullback-tower-levels], compose with the finite quotient model evaluation, and form degreewise chain isomorphisms. Their inverse-image-unit generator formula and the successor transition theorem assemble a strict tower isomorphism natural in all complexes. This records the existing private comparison construction, with no new choice or existence assertion.

source.place: Tag 099N(5), strict finite quotient pullback; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY and 0941, derived adjunction and whole strict tower limit. This is the normalized quotient-system refinement of the original primitive-realization proof, not a verbatim Stacks statement.

proof.text: Take the mate of the whole-sequence direct-image evaluation isomorphism under the actual inverse-image adjunctions. The sequence pullback evaluation theorem inverts this mate. Restrict completed coefficients and compose with M.evaluation, then apply degreewise to complexes. The unit mate formula gives the generator equation.

The successor comparison identifies the adjacent transitions on the generator-normalized level maps. NatTrans.ofOpSequence assembles them into a strict tower map, invertible at every level. NatIso.ofComponents and module comparison naturality make it a natural isomorphism in the complex. All construction fields are explicit and proved.
